content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to connect a 2-wire 230VAC proximity switch to a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. The issue is that the proximity sensor doesn't function when attached directly to the input of the [product_name]. Can someone confirm if direct connection is possible? If so, I would appreciate any guidance on how to set this up. Regards, [user_name]
Hi, How have you wired the sensor? Is one wire connected to L1 and the other to I1, or have you tried a different configuration?
I've connected one wire to L1 and the other to I1.
Hello, Please refer to the [product_name] manual. The solution to this issue has been included in the documentation for several years. This is a similar problem to what you encounter with glow lamps.
Try searching in the manual; you might find some useful information there.
